tasks.title: Load external client requests through an open map
tasks.goal: Replace catalog lock-in with schema-validated package requests and compatibility adapters.
steps: Define descriptor fields for qualified client identity/version, scope/shape matrix, relative destinations, structured keys and requested operations.
Replace fixed client executable/wire slots with an open validated capability map while retaining explicit legacy readers.
Load descriptors as captured data through existing registry admission; attach M-14 context/root/principal and M-16 schema/operation identity.
positive_cases: An external descriptor introduces a new client ID/path/key without rebuilding the engine.
Legacy three-client wire and existing profile views retain explicit compatible behavior.
negative_cases: Unknown schema/operation and duplicate client binding refuse before effects.
Reading a descriptor or detecting a marker grants no write or process authority.

tasks.commit_subject: feat(adapters): admit package-defined client capability maps
notes: Prerequisites M-14-C and M-16-C are mandatory; use their identity/authority contracts.

Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Execute closed generic file and config operations
tasks.goal: Issue and enforce exact host grants for new package-defined destinations and keys.
steps: Implement contained file/tree projection and typed JSON/TOML member reconciliation as closed host semantics.
Expand symbolic roots and member paths to exact resources; check duplicate/ancestor overlap, case aliases and physical containment before grant issuance.
Bind grants to plan/descriptor/operation/resources/root/principal/policy generation; prohibit adapter writes to grant/policy/producer-trust/publication-mode control stores.
positive_cases: A granted new relative destination and new config member reconcile successfully.
Foreign neighboring values and files remain unchanged.
negative_cases: Traversal, alias overlap, self-grant policy edits or broadened resources refuse.
Active MCP launch content is visible in the prepared plan and does not inherit execution approval from a hash.

tasks.title: Preserve receipt ownership through upgrade and revocation
tasks.goal: Extend existing receipts for external descriptors without losing safe inverse operations.
steps: Record descriptor/semantics/grant identities and retained host-readable operation data in the existing receipt families.
Implement upgrade differences for added/retained/removed resources, before-images where supported and locked receipt/digest rechecks.
Implement explicit cross-family adoption and revocation; cleanup uses current separately scoped host authority even after descriptor removal, never revoked native code.
positive_cases: Upgrade preserves foreign members and can restore retained before-images.
A removed descriptor still permits receipt inspection and authorized owned cleanup.
negative_cases: Equal bytes do not transfer ownership; drifted destinations refuse removal.
Missing before-state yields honest non-reversible status; revoked apply cannot run.
